integrity: One compound theorem linking exact finite-size first-entry counts, sharp maximizers, and the random logarithmic settling scale. No independent certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Only labelled synchronous radius-one binary periodic rings of length at least three.
Program checks are finite and corroborative, not proofs of the infinite theorem.
Earlier literature already establishes the local rule, recurrence of periods at most two, fixed-point structure and special-case convergence bounds.
An unindexed equivalent exact first-entry formula remains a residual historical-priority risk.
title: Exact entrance-time census and logarithmic settling for cyclic majority dynamics
